long_biography.plain_text:
Sheikh Mohammed bin Rashid Al Mualla practised flying and parachuting while studying in Britain, then established the Umm Al Quwain Flying Club after returning home. The club offered training for aspiring private pilots and skydivers, with a pay-as-you-fly arrangement and instruction in Cessna aircraft.

His interest in diving extended to environmental work. After training at Dubai's diving club, he took part in clean-ups of Dubai Creek and Umm Al Quwain's creek. In the Emirates Environmental Group's Clean Up UAE campaign, he directed that resources be provided for a beach clean-up involving schools and local agencies.
